source_license: CC BY 4.0, printed on PDF page 1
source_access: Exact publisher PDF retained. Relevant method and result pages text reviewed; width paragraph/table visually inspected. No digitized original fields or geographic edges.

measurements.name: Norwegian Atlantic Slope Current
measurements.source_citation: Fer, I., Bosse, A., and Dugstad, J. (2020), Norwegian Atlantic Slope Current along the Lofoten Escarpment, Ocean Sci., 16, 685–701, doi:10.5194/os-16-685-2020.
measurements.extraction_method: Transcribed published numerical widths after original-page visual review; no field or edge-coordinate digitization.
remaining_gates: Resolve catalog-name equivalence without transferring branch dimensions.
Extract exact section dates, layer support and paired edge coordinates before mapped or seasonal widths.
measurements.range_interpretation: Author-reported characteristic width span from the four-occupation analysis. No midpoint, per-date widths, confidence bounds or annual extrema.
measurements.geographic_scope: Gimsøy hydrographic section near the Lofoten Escarpment; source-defined Norwegian Atlantic Slope Current, not Norwegian Coastal Current.
measurements.section_orientation: Source hydrographic section across the continental slope; no reconstructed geographic edge coordinates.
measurements.layer: Depth-integrated relative geostrophic current. Exact vertical integration limits for the width paragraph are unspecified; nearby mooring/transport layers are not assigned to width.
measurements.time_convention: Four Gimsøy occupations: 2016-07-30, 2016-11-19, 2017-03-08, 2017-06-07. Source reports one characteristic range, not a width value for each date.
measurements.boundary_rule: Lateral depth-integrated relative geostrophic current reduced to 20% of its maximum; geostrophic reference is surface pressure.
measurements.source_locator: Section 2.2, printed p688/PDF p4; Section 5, printed p692/PDF p8, right-column Gimsøy paragraph.
measurements.source_quality_note: Width integration bounds and numerical width uncertainty unspecified. Effective 20.1 km mooring integration width and assumed 4 km error are different quantities. Catalog naming ambiguity remains.

original_regional_context.display_aria_label: Source-defined Norwegian Atlantic Slope Current at Gimsøy: reported 25 to 30 km relative-geostrophic span, no midpoint or annual extrema. Catalog naming ambiguity retained.
original_regional_context.display_caption: Gimsøy: author-reported 25–30 km span at 20% of peak depth-integrated relative geostrophic current. Four occupations, not four dated numerical widths.
original_regional_context.display_method_note: Surface-pressure reference; width integration limits unspecified. The 20.1 km effective mooring integration width and its 4 km assumed error are separate. Norwegian Current naming remains unresolved.
